formulas.raw_gain_loss: gain = sum(max(0, dz)), loss = sum(abs(min(0, dz)))
formulas.smoothed_gain_loss: z_smooth[i] = (z[i-1] + z[i] + z[i+1])/3 with edge reflection
formulas.horn_5m_resampled: Horn 8-neighbor gradient computed on 3x3 grid at 5.0 m spacing
formulas.plane_fit_50m: Least-squares planar regression z = A*x + B*y + C on 5x5 grid (25 points, 10 m spacing, 50 m diameter)
